title: Repo Sync
subtitle: Repository structure syncing and workflow automation tool
description: A Git repository synchronization and management tool for keeping repositories up to date across projects and devices.
It automates common Git workflows for getting and uploading individual or multiple repositories while providing repository settings, licensing, logging, and Pro workflow options.
features: Get or upload one repository or all managed repositories
Manage repository names, branches, remote .git URLs, base paths, and relative paths
Save a default base path through the Settings screen
Base and Pro license support with built-in license management
Pro option to overwrite a local repository when getting the remote repository
Pro custom commit messages for repository uploads
Progress tracking for repository Get and Upload operations
Ability to report errors encountered during use
Ability to submit suggestions and improvement ideas
statusDetails: Complete: Single and all repo overwrite option for Pro
Complete: Git LFS large-file tracking for Pro
Complete: Custom commit messages for Pro
Complete: Get and Upload progress tracking

downloadLinks.title: Product Listing
downloadLinks.body: Automated Git repository sync, backup, and management tool designed for cross-device workflows, version tracking, and easy deployment.

howItWorks: Repo Sync manages saved Git repositories and automates common Get and Upload workflows.
Repositories can be synchronized individually or together, with Pro options for local overwrite, Git LFS tracking, and custom commit messages.
setupInstall: Activate the required RepoSync license if prompted
Set the default Base Path in Settings
Add repositories through Manege Repos using the repository name, branch, .git URL, and path information
apiStructure: The RepoSync backend manages repository settings, licensing, and application-level Git workflows.
Git API modules handle Git operations while the GUI and drivers provide the user interface and connect user actions to the backend.

commonQuestions.question: Does Repo Sync support private repositories?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes, private repositories are supported through your local Git configuration and authentication.

commonQuestions.question: Does it overwrite files automatically?
commonQuestions.answer: Normal synchronization uses Git operations. Pro users can optionally enable overwrite when getting a repository to replace the local repository with the remote copy.

commonQuestions.question: Does it support Linux?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes. Windows and Linux builds are available.
